root_cause_analysis: Meta Graph API returned OAuthException Code 4, Subcode 2207051 ('Application request limit reached' / 'Action is blocked'). The account or application has triggered an automated anti-spam/rate limit restriction preventing publication.
actionable_instructions: Check the Instagram account status directly in the Instagram Mobile App or Meta Business Suite for account action blocks or security checkpoints.
Cease automated posting requests to Meta Graph API for at least 24 hours to allow the application restriction to reset.
Verify Meta Developer App call volume metrics and rate-limit tiers under Meta App Dashboard > Instagram Platform > Rate Limiting.
